prompt.text:
Implement a pure section-row projection.

Export `CatalogItem`, `SectionRow`, and `buildSectionRows`. A catalog item has `sku: string` and `label: string`. A row has `heading: string` and `items: CatalogItem[]`.

`buildSectionRows(sections, busy)` accepts either null or a readonly record whose keys are headings and whose values are readonly item arrays. If `busy` is true, return exactly one row with heading `"Loading"` and an empty item array, regardless of `sections`. If not busy and `sections` is null, return an empty array. Otherwise return one row per own enumerable key, ordered by ascending heading using ordinary string comparison. Preserve item order within each section. The result must deeply copy the rows and item objects so mutations to it cannot affect the input. Empty headings and empty item arrays are valid.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
